parameters.name: BindAssets
parameters.description: The IDs of the protected assets to attach. The value is in the \[**"XX1","XX2",...**] format.

parameters.name: BindResourceGroups
parameters.description: The protected object groups to attach. The value is in the \[**"group1","group2",...**] format.

parameters.name: BindResources
parameters.description: The protected objects to attach. The value is in the \[**"XX1","XX2",...**] format.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection template.

parameters.name: UnbindAssets
parameters.description: The IDs of the protected assets to detach. The value is in the \[**"XX1","XX2",...**] format.

parameters.name: UnbindResourceGroups
parameters.description: The protected object groups to detach. The value is in the \[**"group1","group2",...**] format.

parameters.name: UnbindResources
parameters.description: The protected objects to detach. The value is in the \[**"XX1","XX2",...**] format.
